summary: TalkSport ranks the top-scoring European-based footballers of 2023, with Cristiano Ronaldo of Al Nassr leading on 53 goals after a Boxing Day double against Al Ittihad. Kylian Mbappe and Harry Kane follow on 52, then Erling Haaland on 50, Romelu Lukaku on 40, Santiago Gimenez on 39 and Lautaro Martinez on 37. Mbappe and Kane cannot catch Ronaldo because of winter breaks in France and Germany.
one_line: Ronaldo tops the 2023 goalscoring list with 53 goals, ahead of Mbappe and Kane on 52 and Haaland on 50.
key_facts: Cristiano Ronaldo finished top of the 2023 scoring list with 53 goals: 43 for Al Nassr and ten for Portugal.
Ronaldo's two goals in a 5-2 win against Karim Benzema's Al Ittihad lifted him above Kane and Mbappe.
Ronaldo's 50-plus goals in 2023 mark the eighth time in his career he has scored at least 50 goals in a calendar year.
Kylian Mbappe and Harry Kane are both on 52 goals for 2023 but cannot overtake Ronaldo because PSG and Bayern have no games left due to winter breaks.

Mbappe is PSG's all-time record scorer with 233 goals and has 46 goals for France, ten shy of Giroud's record; his contract at Parc des Princes is in its final year, with Real Madrid favourites to sign him and Liverpool competing.
Harry Kane joined Bayern Munich in August for over £100m and set a Bundesliga record with 17 goals in his first 11 games; he scored nine for England in 2023.
Kane is chasing Uwe Seeler's debut Bundesliga season record of 30 goals (Hamburg, 1963/64) and Robert Lewandowski's single-season record of 41.
Erling Haaland has 50 goals in 2023, only six of them for Norway, and missed Manchester City's last five games with a foot injury.
Haaland broke the Premier League single-season goal record with 36 goals last term, when City won a historic treble.
Romelu Lukaku has 40 goals in 2023 after reuniting with Jose Mourinho at Roma on loan from Chelsea, including four in a 5-0 win over Azerbaijan in November.
Santiago Gimenez, 22, has 39 goals; he scored 15 goals to help Arne Slot's Feyenoord win the Eredivisie, and Arsenal, Tottenham and Chelsea have been linked with him.
Lautaro Martinez has 37 goals, all for Inter Milan, and leads the Serie A Golden Boot race by six over Domenico Berardi.
